description: Create a new site on JAMP and get its install snippet. Use this to set JAMP up on a project: create the site, paste the returned <script> tags into the <head> of the root layout, deploy, then confirm with jamp_verify_install. Requires a token with write access.

domain.description: The site's bare domain, e.g. example.com (no protocol)

name.description: Display name, defaults to the domain

name: jamp_create_site
